_doc.contract: one of the four shared file contracts (CONTRACT §16.4 A8-8 / C-360-81): EXTEND freely, ⛔ RESHAPE only on-board. Producer: pipeline/assemble_tour.mjs (walkthrough-engineer). Consumers: T09 viewer/minimap, T10 ruler/dimensions.
_doc.units: positions and offsets in CENTIMETRES, angles in DEGREES, areas in m², decoded depth in METRES. ⛔ A unit change is a reshape, not an extension.
_doc.frame: x right (+east on the drawing), y down (+south on the drawing); origin = outer NW corner of the building envelope
_doc.scenes: one per plan.json camera_point, in the plan's own order. `pano`/`depth` paths are relative to the tour directory and were validated against manifest.json AND the bytes on disk.
_doc.links: scenes[].links[] — `kind` spot|door, `target` a scene id, `offset_cm` the plan-frame offset from THIS camera to the aim point. Derived angles are in the RENDER's convention (see meta.projection), ⛔ not PSV's.
_doc.minimap: the top view + the world↔uv affine (READ from renders/topview.registration.json, validated here, never recomputed) + room polygons in normalised image coords (u,v ∈ [0,1], v=0 at the image TOP) + room→points.
_doc.rooms: plan.json's own numbers, exact: printed_dims_cm is what the drawing prints, clear_dims_cm is what the trace measures. ⛔ Neither is a measurement of a built unit.
_doc.meta: provenance: the plan + manifest hashes, the pinned date, the depth contract, ceiling-height provenance, and the disclosure KEYS (⛔ never wording).

assembled.date_note: ⛔ NOT a wall clock. Pinned to the newest INPUT timestamp (max of the referenced rows' rendered_utc and manifest.updated_utc) so that a rerun over unchanged inputs is byte-identical.

plan.scale_basis: least-squares fit through the origin on FOUR printed dimensions only (MAMAD 280 + 330, toilet 125 + 165): 1.0448 px/cm (0.95712 cm/px). Every other printed dimension is a held-out check, not a fit input.
plan.rights_note: developer floor-plan drawing supplied by הרי זהב for the Habait project pages; what a CG tour derived from it may be shown to is OQ-360-11 (Slava's). CONTRACT A8-13 / C-360-85.
assumptions: ceiling_height_cm 260 is ASSUMED - the drawing carries no section and no height dimension
parapet height 110 cm on both balconies and the service balcony is ASSUMED
window sill/head heights are ASSUMED - the drawing is a plan only
camera eye height 140 cm is ported from the reference product (research/walkaround-reference/REPORT.md 2.1), not from this drawing

disagreements.why: the printed 185 cannot be honoured without contradicting three printed dimensions the drawing DOES satisfy exactly. The bathroom's south wall is the MAMAD's north wall; the whole west N-S chain (bath / MAMAD 330 / bedroom 305 / master 395) measures to within 0.5 cm end to end at the fitted scale. Moving that one wall 9.3 cm would break the other three. Excluded from the T14 measurement-accuracy population - it is a drawing-internal conflict, not a pipeline error.

virtual_boundaries: r-kitchen north (y) and east (x) are open-plan zone boundaries with NO drawn line. The north one is placed from the PRINTED depth 362, so that number is CIRCULAR and is not usable as ruler ground truth. The east one lands on the south balcony's west edge, a drawn line, and independently reproduces the printed width 278 to -0.6 cm.
r-living west is an open-plan boundary placed on the hall east wall's west face extended south - a DRAWN structural line, not the printed 368; it independently reproduces the printed 368 to +2.4 cm.
r-corridor / r-dining are one physically continuous space split on the free-standing partition's own line (SCHEMA 6).
r-master / r-master-lobby are split on the master bedroom's east wall line extended north.

manifest.render_quality_note: ⚠ the newest batch's `mode` describes what these panos ARE today. T13 re-renders the pilot; nothing here claims final quality.

ceiling.why: ceiling_height_cm 260 is ASSUMED - the drawing carries no section and no height dimension

depth.decode: (R<<16 | G<<8 | B) / scale ⇒ metres (radial distance from the camera origin, NOT planar depth)
depth.refusal: ⛔ C-360-83: a decoder meeting an encoding/scale it does not know THROWS. It never falls back. This assembler refuses to emit a scene whose row declares anything else.

projection.col_mapping: u = (col+0.5)/W ; u=0.5 = camera forward ; u increases to the right
projection.png_scanline_order: top row first (this file flips the Blender buffer)

angles.bearing_deg: plan bearing of the offset: 0 = −y (up on the drawing), 90 = +x, clockwise, [0,360) — SCHEMA §1
angles.az_from_forward_deg: azimuth measured FROM this scene's camera forward (its yaw_deg), positive toward the viewer's RIGHT — the sidecar's own 'u=0.5 = forward, u increases to the right'
angles.texture_uv: the equirect texture coordinate of the aim direction: u = wrap01(0.5 + az/360), v = 0.5 − elev/180, v=0 at the image TOP
angles.psv: ⛔ NOT PhotoSphereViewer coordinates. T09 maps these to PSV and measures the mapping.

disclosure.note: ⛔ KEYS ONLY — no wording is authored in this file. DS-9's words are Slava's (OQ-360-10, A8-19/C-360-87); the viewer resolves each key per language through app/src/ui/copy.ts.

graph.rule: SCHEMA §6 / F-360-116 — an edge is an OPENING's own `rooms` pair. ⛔ Never reverse-indexed from walls: a footprint wall here bounds up to five rooms.
graph.aim_rule: `best_aim` per link: 'target' = the prescribed aim (the far room's nearest point at door mid-height) has a clear line from this camera; 'opening' = it does not, but the doorway does — render the marker at `via_opening.offset_cm`; 'none' = neither is visible from here (the route turns a corner), so a marker painted in either direction lands on a wall. Pure plan geometry (segment vs wall footprint, the opening's own 3-D aperture as the hole) — ⛔ no depth is read.

room_mask.decode: match the pixel's exact RGB triple against rooms[].rgb; (0,0,0) = no room
room_mask.anti_aliasing: NONE — rasterised from plan.json's room loops at pixel centres, even-odd rule

registration.world_to_uv: u = (x_cm − origin_cm[0]) / span_cm[0] ; v = (y_cm − origin_cm[1]) / span_cm[1]
registration.uv_to_world: x_cm = origin_cm[0] + u·span_cm[0] ; y_cm = origin_cm[1] + v·span_cm[1]
registration.uv_note: u,v are EDGE-based continuous image coordinates in [0,1] (0 = the left/top edge of the image). ⚠ The sidecar's polygon_px are pixel-CENTRE indices: u = (col_px + 0.5)/width, v = (row_px + 0.5)/height. Half a pixel is 0.62 cm here.
registration.no_flip: row 0 is the image's TOP scanline and the SMALLEST plan y — the affine flips neither axis (plan y grows downward, SCHEMA §1)
